A CLEAN PAPER TRAIL

Sources & downloads.

↓ Download listening library

All 467 CC0 originals have local MP3 listening copies. The 51 existing game samples are also included for comparison. Listening copies are mono 44.1 kHz / 96 kbps; level matching is optional during playback. Source recordings and their hashes remain unchanged in the repository.

Weapon files often contain several takes. Detected boundaries are approximate; open a recording to hear every take or the entire session. Domestic dog recordings are canine references, not authentic wolf calls. Creature effects and performed voices are labeled separately from natural recordings.
